SELECT c.instructor_id AS coachId,
COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(ins.name), ''), MAX(c.instructor_name), '') AS coachName, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(o.order_count, 0)), 0) AS orderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(o.paid_amount, 0)), 0), 2) AS paidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cons.lesson_count, 0)), 0) AS lessonCount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cons.service_persons, 0)), 0) AS servicePersons FROM la_course_class c LEFT JOIN la_instructor ins ON ins.id = c.instructor_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o1.course_class_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o1.order_amount) AS paid_amount FROM la_recharge_order o1 WHERE o1.pay_status = 1 AND o1.delete_time IS NULL AND (o1.refund_status <> 1 OR o1.refund_status IS NULL) AND o1.pay_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} GROUP BY o1.course_class_id ) o ON o.course_class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cl.course_class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.lesson_no) AS lesson_count, COUNT(*) AS service_persons FROM la_course_consume_log cl WHERE cl.create_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} GROUP BY cl.course_class_id ) cons ON cons.course_class_id = c.id WHERE c.is_delete = 0
AND c.instructor_id = #{q.instructorId}
GROUP BY c.instructor_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(o.order_count, 0)), 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cons.service_persons, 0)), 0) > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS couponOrderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.order_amount), 0), 2) AS couponOrderAmount FROM la_recharge_order o WHERE o.course_class_id = 0 AND o.coupon_goods_id > 0 AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.delete_time IS NULL AND (o.refund_status <> 1 OR o.refund_status IS NULL) AND o.pay_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch}

SELECT cl.course_class_id AS courseClassId, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS courseName, cl.lesson_no AS lessonNo, COUNT(*) AS servicePersons, MAX(cl.create_time) AS lastConsumeTime FROM la_course_consume_log cl JOIN la_course_class c ON c.id = cl.course_class_id AND c.is_delete = 0 WHERE cl.create_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} AND c.instructor_id = #{q.instructorId} GROUP BY cl.course_class_id, c.name, cl.lesson_no ORDER BY cl.course_class_id ASC, cl.lesson_no ASC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.limit}

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.sn AS sn, o.course_class_id AS courseClassId, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS courseName, COALESCE(o.student_id, 0) AS studentId, COALESCE(s.name, '') AS studentName, COALESCE(o.lesson_count, 0) AS lessonCount, o.order_amount AS orderAmount, o.pay_time AS payTime FROM la_recharge_order o JOIN la_course_class c ON c.id = o.course_class_id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN la_student s ON s.id = o.student_id WHERE c.instructor_id = #{q.instructorId} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.delete_time IS NULL AND (o.refund_status <> 1 OR o.refund_status IS NULL) AND o.pay_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} ORDER BY o.pay_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.limit}
